# Selection for improved flight performance

## Dry mass of adults

See Methods section for details of experimental set-up.

### Call relevant packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
library(gt)
library(modelsummary)
library(patchwork)
library(officer)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

### Import and wrangle data

Imported into a tibble "Mass_data_raw" and processed into "Mass_data"

```{r}
Mass_data_raw <- read_excel("~/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Raw_data/DryMassData.xlsx", na = "NA")

# Get dry mass per fly
Mass_data_raw <- Mass_data_raw %>% 
  mutate(DryMassTechnical = `DryMass(10e-4 g)`/BatchSize) %>% 
  drop_na()

Mass_data <- Mass_data_raw %>% group_by(Selection, PopReplicate, Vial, Sex, VialSample) %>% 
  summarise(DryMass = mean(DryMassTechnical)) %>% 
  mutate(PopRep = paste(Selection, PopReplicate, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(VialNest = paste(PopRep, Vial, sep = "_V")) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate", "PopRep", "Sex", "VialNest"), factor) %>% mutate(Sex = fct_recode(Sex, "Female" = "F", "Male" = "M"))
  
```

## Analysis

### AIC model selection

```{r}
# Only selection
fit_sel1 <- lmer(data = Mass_data, REML = FALSE,
                DryMass ~ Selection + (1|PopRep))

# Only sex
fit_sex2 <- lmer(data = Mass_data, REML = FALSE,
                DryMass ~ Sex + (1|PopRep))

# Full factorial model
fit_full3 <- lmer(data = Mass_data, REML = FALSE,
                DryMass ~ Selection * Sex + (1|PopRep))

aictab(cand.set = list(fit_sel1, fit_sex2, fit_full3))
```

Based on AICc scores, the fully factorial model with main and interaction effects of Selection and Sex has been selected.

### Calculating effect sizes

Both eta-squared and Cohen's F (analogous to Cohen's D when there are 2 levels) are calculated for the models with the highest support according to AICc.

```{r}
fit_full_reml <- lmer(data = Mass_data, REML = TRUE,
                DryMass ~ Selection * Sex + (1|PopRep))

eta_squared(fit_full_reml)
cohens_f(fit_full_reml)

```

### Analyse sexes separately

```{r}
# Female
F_Mass_data <- Mass_data %>% filter(Sex == "Female")

fit_sel_f <- lmer(data = F_Mass_data, REML = TRUE,
                DryMass ~ Selection + (1|PopRep))
anova(fit_sel_f)
eta_squared(fit_sel_f)

M_Mass_data <- Mass_data %>% filter(Sex == "Male")

fit_sel_m <- lmer(data = M_Mass_data, REML = TRUE,
                DryMass ~ Selection + (1|PopRep))
anova(fit_sel_m)
eta_squared(fit_sel_m)

mass_tables <- list(e_fullmassmod = eta_squared(fit_full_reml),
                    a_fit_sel_f = tidy(anova(fit_sel_f)),
                    a_fit_sel_m = tidy(anova(fit_sel_m)),
                    e_fit_sel_f = eta_squared(fit_sel_f),
                    e_fit_sel_m = eta_squared(fit_sel_m))
```

### Plots

```{r}
mass_plot <- Mass_data %>% rename(Replicate = PopReplicate) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Selection, y = DryMass, color = Selection)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Replicate), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(.~Sex, scales = "free_y") +
  stat_summary(fun = 'mean', color = 'black', size = 4, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
    values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
    values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) + labs(x = "Selection", y = "Dry Mass (10^-4g)") 

print(mass_plot)
```

#### Save plot

```{r}
# Save plot data
saveRDS(mass_plot, file = "../../Plots/ggplot_files/mass_plot.RDS")
```

Save tables

```{r}
saveRDS(mass_tables, "../../Tables/mass_tables.RDS")
```
